'''Rendili Hyperworks''' was a [[Rendili/Legends|Rendili]]-based company<ref name="KOTORCG" /> affiliated with the [[Rendili Vehicle Corporation/Legends|Rendili Vehicle Corporation]] and [[Rendili StarDrive/Legends|Rendili StarDrive]].

==History==
[[File:Rendili_Facility.jpg|thumb|left|250px|[[Hammerhead-class cruiser|''Hammerhead''-class cruisers]] under construction]]
During the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]], Rendili Hyperworks created the [[Praetorian-class frigate|''Praetorian''-class frigate]] and the [[Hammerhead-class cruiser|''Hammerhead''-class cruiser]]. Some time later, the company sold the blueprints of the ''Praetorian'' design to [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]], which retooled the design into the [[Class VI bulk freighter]].<ref name="KOTORCG" />

The company also produced the [[Inexpugnable-class tactical command ship|''Inexpugnable''-class tactical command ship]] in cooperation with the [[Vanjervalis Systems]] conglomerate.<ref name="KOTORCG" /> This business venture went under the name the [[Rendili/Vanjervalis Drive Yards]].<ref name="KOTORHD">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic Handbook]]''</ref>

The company produced the [[Leviathan-class transport|''Leviathan''-class transport]] for the purpose of transporting various supplies and personnel to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ruhnuk]] and bringing [[Ore/Legends|ore]] off the planet. Some of these transports were modified by the [[Hidden Chain]] into [[Hidden Chain Fleet Ship|Hidden Chain Fleet Ships]].<ref name="HiddenChainFleetShip"/>
